scope: Repository-evidence-based request for project-owner and source-owner decisions. No source contact or access was performed.

D2_rainfall_source_and_access.decision_maker: Project owner plus accountable source owner
D2_rainfall_source_and_access.required_decision: Select one exact source/product for replay or live prototype, reject candidates, or defer; document all evidence fields in each selected candidate record.

D3_reservoir_source_and_access.decision_maker: Project owner plus authoritative reservoir source owner/custodian
D3_reservoir_source_and_access.required_decision: Identify authoritative record holder and select an exact authorized feed or bounded replay input, reject candidates, or defer; document fields, measurement semantics and permissions.

options: bounded live prototype using specifically authorized source(s)
D8_prototype_source_mode.required_decision: Choose source mode separately from D2/D3; if live is chosen, name exact approved sources, terms, rate limits, secret custody, rollback boundary, and exclusions.
D8_prototype_source_mode.current_safe_behavior: No connected feed. B35 is fixture-only; B36 keeps the product demo fixture as the provider and shows unconnected sources unavailable.

c3_policy.observation_time_and_timezone: Unknown/null for historical date-only records; do not synthesize midnight or infer Asia/Kolkata.

no_approval_inference: Silence, public URLs, local historical holdings, existing terms labels, and prior downloads do not authorize a live connection.
Historical REPLAY records do not establish a current feed, service entitlement, update SLA, or source-owner agreement.
No source is marked verified-live or authorized-for-live by this package.
downstream_rule: Do not register or start a source-specific adapter/connector task until the selected source, permissions, sample/schema provenance, field/time/unit semantics, freshness expectations, and D8 mode decision are documented. Then define exact owned paths, tests, security boundaries, rollback, and gate/change-control impacts.
